[docs/cli.md#pskit-remove]
With `--keep-resources` the kept resources are taken out of the Terraform state first, so pskit no longer manages them: delete them in the cloud console when you no longer need them, or import them into another stack. The code-upload bucket is not kept. On Azure the storage account, Service Bus namespace and resource group that hold kept queues, containers or topics are kept as well. Supported on AWS, GCP, Azure, Alibaba, Tencent, Huawei and Oracle; the other providers create no buckets, queues or topics.

[docs/cli.md#pskit-resources-onprem]
Deleting a deployed resource runs `terraform destroy -target=...`. If it is still in `pskit.yml`, the next deploy creates it again, so remove it from `resources:` (or the trigger) first. Kept resources are deleted from their own small workspace in `.pskit/<provider>-<stage>/kept/`, which is removed when the last one is gone. Credentials are the same as for `pskit deploy`.
